mappings.reason: ADR 0046/0019: stored typed startup strictness selects real private ICU line rules across common Font layouts, retained TextServer/TextParagraph and scene Label consumers. Effective features are captured at first nonempty line analysis; explicit locale options override the default, Auto preserves native locale tailoring, and later edits require restart. Bounded requested-locale caching preserves warm allocation behavior. LineBreakingStrictnessTests checks fresh-process modes/features, persistence/validation, independent native oracle vectors, 1024 zero-owner/all-thread boundary calls, actual local software Wayland/X11 GPU/Compatibility CJK pixels and prepared native owner allocation. Hardware/foreign/editor/native allocation acceptance remains separate.
